title: Buy, Build, Deploy: Using M&A to Drive AI Transformation — Prathik Naidu, Long Lake
talk_summary: This is an M&A/investment thesis talk about acquiring services businesses and applying AI to improve their P&L, not an engineering talk.

takeaways.technique: Live-operations feedback loop as eval signal
takeaways.what_they_do: They argue that owning a business gives you real tasks, edge cases, and ground-truth answers on whether an agent got something right, which can be used to improve agents/models.
takeaways.evidence_quote: a live environment with real tasks, real edge cases, and real answers on whether or not an agent actually got something right

takeaways.what_they_do: They screen ~5,000 deals/year but apply a very narrow filter, explicitly framing selection as the core discipline.
takeaways.evidence_quote: you have to keep a big funnel, and then an incredibly tight filter
